$comment: The toolchain every build and every recorded figure assumes. Metal has no container image to pin, as Charlotte pinned emsdk's, so the versions are pinned here instead and tools/check_toolchain.py compares them with the machine's at configure time: the compilers CMake resolved (C++; C and Objective-C, which build SDL; Objective-C++, which builds the display link), the SDK the build compiles against, the Metal compiler, Xcode, and CMake, whose version decides the compile lines; a mismatch stops the build. To move to a new Xcode or CMake, change this file in its own commit and rerun the tests: a new Metal compiler can change what the shaders compute.
$lint: The formatter and the static checks, LLVM's, which the build does not run: make format, format-check and tidy, and clangd in the editor (docs/process/workflow.md). The formatter's output depends on its version, so it is pinned with the others; tools/check_toolchain.py --lint checks these alone, and only those targets ask it to, so a machine without them still builds. brew install llvm.
